direct_edit_prohibitions: Do not edit generated Section 99 views as authority.
Do not promote prototype PHP seeds, runtime state, backups, or copied SSOT bundles.
Do not write to center seeds or publish until persistence/auth/release controls exist.
Do not silently repair a conflict by copying the most convenient value.

routes.authority_family: controlled production program and supporting documentation
routes.authority_rule: Each DOCX governs only its declared domain; supporting documents reference PGM/TECH/FIN identities and never create competing show order or timing.
steps: Extract text/tables to a temporary workspace.
Record source path, SHA-256, locator, method, and stated use.
Reconcile conflicts without choosing unsupported facts.
Update affected leaf, manifest, registers, handoff, and validator.
routes.failure_behavior: Stop promotion, retain prior approved revision if one exists, register the conflict/blocker, and preserve safety precedence.
routes.safe_edit_boundary: Never modify the controlled DOCX during extraction and never infer approval from repository presence.

routes.authority_family: legacy human-readable repository documentation and paired machine-readable seed contracts
routes.authority_rule: Update the domain-specific human source, its paired docs/ssot JSON, and docs/ssot/master_index.json together; paired data remains evidence until reconciled into the compendium.
steps: Edit the domain authority first.
Update its paired JSON without adding unsupported claims.
Update the master index in the same change.
Validate JSON and review the diff before derivation.
validation_commands: python3 -c "import json, pathlib; [json.loads(p.read_text()) for p in pathlib.Path('docs/ssot').rglob('*.json')]"
routes.failure_behavior: Reject partial propagation; do not derive or publish a view from mismatched inputs.
routes.safe_edit_boundary: Do not treat onboarding prompts, copied bundles, or prototype values as automatic canon.

routes.authority_family: paired SSOT indexes and settings seeds
routes.authority_rule: Center discovers paired SSOT/settings as read-only seed truth; app-local PHP arrays are prototype scaffolding rather than authority.
steps: Load the settings manifest and master index.
Resolve declared paths rather than duplicating facts in templates.
Keep user changes in a draft overlay.
Promote only through authenticated, audited, backed-up controlled workflow.
routes.failure_behavior: Fall back to read-only display; block writes/publication; record adapter or freshness failure.
routes.safe_edit_boundary: No runtime editing, upload, publication, approval stamp, contact storage, or deletion until authentication, permissions, audit, backup, rollback, revision, and export controls exist.

routes.authority_family: review-stage compendium authority and schema families
routes.authority_rule: Leaves are maintained authorities/records; the manifest catalog and validation report are synchronized derivatives of live leaf identity and state, while the manifest envelope remains controlled.
routes.mode: manual authoring plus deterministic catalog synchronization
steps: Author a bounded leaf with provenance and pending approval.
Synchronize manifest identity/status/revision/scaffold state.
Extend durable invariant checks.
Re-audit state totals and update progress/handoff prose.
routes.failure_behavior: Classify mismatches invalid, do not commit stale handoff/catalog state, and repair from audited leaves.
routes.safe_edit_boundary: Do not direct-edit generated catalog rows independently of leaf state and do not call review content approved.

routes.authority_family: approved release inputs and disposable public/owner views
routes.authority_rule: Views and exports may be generated only from identified current approved inputs and evidence-cleared release gates.
routes.mode: automated only after controlled release gates
steps: Verify approved revision and immutable input hashes.
Evaluate rights, safety, privacy, venue, accessibility, copy, media, disclosure, and affiliation gates.
Generate, validate, and record inputs/method.
Publish only the approved output scope.
validation_commands: future release-specific gate suite (not yet implemented)
routes.failure_behavior: Fail closed, preserve the prior approved release, and register the failed gate; never use prototype seeds as fallback canon.
routes.safe_edit_boundary: Generated views are disposable and must not be directly edited or used to back-propagate facts.
